faqs.q: Can it work with our task tool?
faqs.a: Asana, Trello, ClickUp, Notion and monday.com are all in viaSocket’s catalog. Name yours in the sentence to Captain.

faqs.q: What if a site we use has no app?
faqs.a: A browser agent can read it like a person would, and asks before it submits anything. See [how to automate a website that has no API](/guides/how-to-automate-a-website-that-has-no-api).

faqs.q: How do I know an automation stopped working?
faqs.a: Each automation’s Overview shows its runs and the ones that did not work, so a failure shows up the same day.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: A browser agent will not get past CAPTCHAs or bot checks; sites that block automated visits stay manual. It does not two-way sync two apps; each automation runs in one direction. Posting to a shared Slack channel asks for your approval each time today.
